job.job_description:
Knowledge of one server-side or Backend programming language like Java, Python, Ruby, Net etc.
Skills you require to become a back-end developer: Web Development Languages, Database and Cache, Server, API (REST SOAP).
Handling servers like Apache, Nginx, IIS servers, Microsoft IIS.
Solid background in Linux helps tremendously in administering servers.
Mandatory Skills
Knowledge and experience in MySQL, MongoDB.
Understanding the AWS Mobile Hub or Firebase.
Back End web developer should have the skills for implementing algorithms and solving system related problems.
Manage APIs resources which work across devices.
Preferred Skills
Full knowledge of AWS Mobile Hub or Firebase.
Exploit the CSS pre-processors (server-side), both.
